title: pm(dispatch-gates): clause-② prose in dispatch-gates.mjs (docblocks + every `--tier` printout) and core-rules.md:124 still describes a BUILD-tier mandate once the 强制条款② narrowing lands
body:
Filed by the `os-dev` executor of #16905 (branch `claude/issue-16905-clause2-build-tier`, `session_01TezFG8ZMrNH6n5VTNpPpdH`), unassigned, as an out-of-scope finding. **Re-scoped in the #16905 patch round**: the director seat widened PR #16915's file surface to `references/contract-review.md`, `references/core-rules.md` and `references/lanes/cli.md`, so every `references/**` site this card originally listed (including `core-rules.md:124`) is now rewritten in that PR. What remains here is `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` prose only — `scripts/pm/**` stays fenced out of that PR (its H4: report the site, do not edit the script).

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#16905

## What #16905's PR changes

强制条款② in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈派发〉 goes from "clause-② cards are BUILT and reviewed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`" to "built at the default judgment tier, reviewed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`", and the `references/**` copies of the mandate are rewritten in the same PR. If the maintainer rejects that PR this card is moot and should be closed as not planned.

## Prose in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` that still describes clause ② as a BUILD-tier mandate (verified on `origin/main` at `0939ba008`)

1. The `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` docblock (around line 10160): "clause ②'s CONTRACT-REVIEW tier: the tier a card that changes contract accept/reject behaviour or widens the public surface must be **dispatched** at, and the tier the `needs:contract-review` re-review sub-round must itself be running at". After #16905 only the second half holds.
2. The `MANDATORY_TIER_GLOBS` docblock (around line 10219): "clause ②, NOT encoded and deliberately not: a card that changes contract accept/reject behaviour or widens the public surface is also `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`". The "not encoded" half is exactly right and is what #16905's H4 relied on; the "is also `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`" half becomes a review-tier statement, not a build-tier one.
3. `tierLines` (around lines 10393-10404) — printed on EVERY `--tier` run: "Clause ② is NOT reachable from paths: a card that changes contract accept/reject behaviour or widens the public surface is fable-mandatory too, judged from the card CONTENT", and the SUSPECT tail "(a card changing contract accept/reject behaviour or widening the public surface is `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`)". A PM reading the instrument's output after #16905 lands is told to dispatch clause-② cards at the ceiling, contradicting the skill. The trailing "whichever tier is dispatched, the PR's actual diff passes the clause-② enqueue gate before the card may enqueue" is already the post-#16905 shape and needs no change.

## Not a behaviour change

`deriveTier` derives a path mandate for the clause-① globs only; no code path encodes clause ② (grep `clause` in the script: all hits are prose or printed strings). So this is drift in what the instrument SAYS, not in what it decides — hence `finding`, no severity asserted. The fix is a prose edit in one script, verified by the script's own test suite (`scripts/pm/*.test.*` naming `dispatch-gates`).
